strip.stripTitle: “usual day” is the size of a typical daily move for that name — its own last 60 sessions [standard deviation; sigma means the same thing, and we say “usual day” instead of either]. An ordinary day is about 1×; 2× happens about 1 day in 20; 3× about 1 day in 370. It is stored once a day for every name, so every screen divides by the same number. · rules 2026-09-24.1 · equities 2× or 8% · indexes 2.5× or 3% · sectors 2.5× or 4% · the spark is criticality over the last 8h — a first measure only, 7 of 60 sessions stored, so no probability is claimed yet · tap to open the notifications, where every one of today’s is listed.
